tools.name: list_operations
tools.title: List operations
tools.description: Lists every operation the backend supports, with ids. Use this when you need an operation id for execute_operation.

tools.name: get_operation_schema
tools.title: Get operation schema
tools.description: Returns the JSON Schema of an operation's parameters. Use this before execute_operation.

tools.name: execute_operation
tools.title: Execute operation
tools.description: Executes any backend operation by id with the given parameters. Long operations run as tasks.
